product.name: Aurelio Scientific Slide Rack Standard
product.description: The Aurelio Scientific Slide Rack Standard is a durable storage solution designed for laboratory microscopes. It holds up to ten 1‑inch slides in a compact, vertically oriented frame. The rack features a reinforced metal spine and a smooth plastic base that protects specimens from dust and accidental damage. Its lightweight construction (0.5 kg) allows easy relocation between benches or cabinets. The black finish offers a neutral aesthetic that blends with most lab environments. The rack is compatible with standard microscope slide holders and can be stacked for efficient use of limited space. Ideal for researchers, teaching labs, and quality control teams.
